description: Host-managed setup only. The user adds the PandaDoc API key in Settings → Connectors in the app. Do not ask for or accept the key in chat. Get an API key from the PandaDoc Developer Dashboard: Settings → API → Developer Dashboard → Generate a Sandbox key (for testing) or Production key (for live use). Note: API access requires a PandaDoc Business or Enterprise plan.

api_key.description: The PandaDoc API key from Settings > API > Developer Dashboard
